examples.en: Her confidence has been slowly eroded by repeated failures.
examples.zh: 她的自信心因屡屡失败慢慢消磨掉了。

examples.en: There were also several accidents mainly caused by engine failures on take-off.
examples.zh: 还有一些事故主要是由起飞时引擎故障导致的。

examples.en: The bank set aside 1.1 billion dollars to cover bad debts from business failures.
examples.zh: 银行留出11亿美元来支付生意失败导致的坏账。
